name: iris-verify-ui
title_zh: 截图对照设计稿，逐像素揪出视觉偏差
tagline_zh: 前端改完不敢合？拿它对照设计稿截图，自动定位偏差坐标，还能裁剪局部反复核验，比肉眼盯图靠谱十倍。
tagline_en: Scared to merge frontend changes? Compare against design screenshots, get exact diff coordinates, crop regions.
desc_en: Verify web UIs, HTML, and interface screenshots with dsh-iris through repeatable capture, semantic inspection, element location, cropping, pixel-diff analysis, and bounded rechecks. Use when comparing a UI with a reference image, locating visual regressions, validating frontend changes, or matching an implementation to a design. 用于对照参考图检查界面、定位视觉偏差、验证前端修改或比较两张 UI 截图。
why_zh: 不靠模糊的视觉猜测，而是可重复的捕获+语义检查+像素差分闭环，每次核验都有据可查，偏差定位到坐标级。
why_en: No vague eyeballing—repeatable capture, semantic inspection, and pixel-diff in one loop, pinning regressions to exact coordinates.
limit_zh: 只认 dsh-iris 后端和本地可访问的 UI/截图；不做跨浏览器渲染对比，也不修 CSS，只负责找出差异并给出坐标。
limit_en: Requires dsh-iris backend and locally accessible UIs/screenshots. No cross-browser rendering or CSS fixes—only detects and locates diffs.
title_en: Pixel-diff UI checker against reference designs
